prOriginal.nota: Given in in.json (prOriginalConhecido); confirmed: squash commit d762a96436 'Unified Storage: Init at startup, fix traces, and speed up indexing (#97529)' is the first search.go commit on main on 2024-12-10.

unified-storage-performance-optimization.reason: The bug depends on searchSupport.init subscribing its own WatchWriteEvents reader and draining it in a handleEvent goroutine before server.initWatcher subscribes the broadcaster. PR #110861 'Cleanup of old search functionality' (2025-09-11) removed indexing on watch events, deleting that WatchWriteEvents subscription and goroutine from search.go (bisected: present at b3cc317, gone at 6fa6a57). It was a broad cleanup, not a fix for this ordering. Today server.Init still runs search.init before initWatcher, but search no longer reads write events, so the described search-reader-before-broadcaster mechanism is gone.

astra.pergunta: Search's WatchWriteEvents reader was removed by #110861 but search.init still runs before initWatcher today: confirmado, pendente or descontinuado?
astra.resposta: descontinuado. #110861 removed the search watch subscription and draining goroutine as part of a broader rewrite, eliminating the reported mechanism without specifically fixing this bug. The remaining order can still leave a pre-subscription gap, but it no longer involves a search reader receiving events before the broadcaster subscribes.
